metadata.title: Coexist: Differentiable Alloy Phase Diagrams from Production-Engine Energetics (code, campaign scripts, and numerical outputs)
metadata.description: Code and data archive accompanying the paper 'Differentiable Alloy Phase Diagrams from Production-Engine Energetics' (submitted to Computational Materials Science). Coexist treats common-tangent and invariant phase-diagram constructions as implicit layers: differentiating a fixed-iteration Newton solver with jax.grad returns derivatives of liquidus, solidus, solvus, and invariant points with respect to any upstream parameter, from engine-computed energetics down to a real potential parameter of an unmodified production engine (LAMMPS, MACE-MP-0). The archive contains the full library, the per-result campaign scripts in examples/ (each paper result regenerates from a single script, with numerical outputs stored as JSON), the interatomic potential files with NIST provenance, the pytest suite, and the manuscript sources.
